lowerMassLogic: The complete mass-36 frontier has global maximum integer depth 4. Point-pencil addition cannot increase depth. Therefore every mass-40 depth-5 class is necessarily born in the no-contained-pencil sector.
theorem: The complete mass-40 no-contained-pencil sector has 422280 vectors in 30 PSp(4,3) orbits. Exactly two orbits, of sizes 216 and 4320, have integer depth 5. All 30 orbits satisfy delta_R=d; in particular both first depth-5 births have gamma_R=20 and delta_R=d=5. Together with the complete mass-36 maximum-depth-4 theorem, this proves that depth 5 is first born at mass 40 and has at least these two inequivalent birth orbits, with this sector exhaustively complete.
boundary: Exact finite combinatorics and integer/rational signed-preimage optimization only. Depth and delta_R are not physical energy, fault-tolerance cost, or hardware performance.
